|translation='''Title:''' It Could Be Worse.

'''Card text:'''
When you would lose Force, you may spend X Force to reduce the Force you lose by X.

'''Lore:'''
After escaping Detention Block AA-23, the Rebels came out into the garbage compactor. Leia says, “It could have been worse.” Well, that is still to come.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is もっとひどい目にあったかも.
